easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
